acceptance: RUBRIC 1 a workflow_run gate run's title identifies its source (head SHA or PR) and the scheduled run is the only one titled sweep, pinned by a workflow test
context:
2026-10-27: Merge freeze (owner 2026-10-27, scope: oracle-code PRs): no PR that changes oracle reviewer or gate code merges, and no make pr-arm runs on one, until oracle-history-edited-review-fail-closed-20261027 is merged. In scope: #3565, #3572, #3573, #3574, #3576, the unopened scope-path, evidence-exempt and redaction branches, and any other PR touching _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/, _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py, _project/scripts/soundness_merge_digest.py, scripts/pr_arm.py or .github/workflows/oracle-*.yml. Excepted: the edited-review fix's own PR and #3585 (owner exemption 2026-10-27). PRs may be opened and reviewed meanwhile. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, including on test PRs; edit-detection proofs use unit fixtures and read-only GraphQL reads of existing reviews.

2026-10-26: the bridge and push sweep are removed by retire-oracle-review-workflow-20261021; re-check the run names after that merges (likely moot).
description: oracle-gate.yml's run-name falls back to 'sweep' when the event has no pull_request or issue number, so every workflow_run-triggered gate run (which runs the single-PR gate job) is titled 'oracle-gate (workflow_run pr=sweep)', the same as the hourly cron sweep. During the 2026-10-22 queue investigation this was misread as a full sweep of every open PR on each oracle completion. CHANGE: title workflow_run gate runs with the source run's head SHA or resolved PR, and keep 'sweep' for the scheduled sweep only.
